fullDescription: A premium Apple-inspired SaaS dashboard design characterized by its ultra-clean, minimalist aesthetic. It utilizes an Apple Mail/Weather-style interface with soft neutral backgrounds, high-contrast white cards, and a refined typographic hierarchy. The style is optimized for complex software applications requiring clarity and high professional standards, such as fintech, environmental monitoring, or marketing automation platforms. Features include 3D-effect cards with 20px border radii, glassmorphism navigation bars, and sophisticated micro-interactions for toggles and buttons. Keywords: white mode, Apple design language, minimalist SaaS, professional dashboard, environmental communications, data visualization cards, high-contrast UI, multi-channel preview.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, high-performance multi-column dashboard focused on publishing and communication management. It mirrors the 'Pro' look of Apple's system interfaces, emphasizing content through generous whitespace, subtle shadows, and a neutral color palette accented by functional status colors.

style.description: The style is built on a foundation of 'Inter' typography and a neutral gray palette. Surfaces use a layered approach: a light gray base (#f5f5f7) with elevated white cards (#ffffff) featuring soft shadows. Accent colors follow Apple's standard human interface guidelines: #0071e3 (Blue), #34c759 (Green), and #ff3b30 (Red). Animation is restrained, focusing on 0.2s cubic-bezier transitions for hover and active states.
style.prompt:
### Core Style Guide
- **Base Colors**: Background: #f5f5f7; Surface/Card: #ffffff; Primary Text: #1d1d1f; Secondary Text: #86868b; Divider: #e5e5ea.
- **Accent Colors**: Apple Blue: #0071e3; Apple Green: #34c759; Apple Red: #ff3b30; AI/Sparkle Purple: #8b5cf6.
- **Typography**: Primary Font: 'Inter', sans-serif. Headings: 28px/700; Section Titles: 17px/600; Body: 14px-15px/400; Labels: 13px/500.
- **Geometry**: Cards: 20px border-radius; Inputs/Buttons: 12px; Selectors: 10px; Small Badges: 6px.
- **Shadows**: Soft elevation (0 2px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)).
- **Micro-interactions**: 200ms ease-in-out transitions for all hover states. Toggles use a physical 'slide' animation with a green (#34c759) activation color.

layout_and_structure.description: A responsive 3-column layout (320px | 700px flex | 350px) with a persistent sticky header and a comprehensive historical data section at the bottom.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header (height: 64px) using white background with 90% opacity and 12px blur (backdrop-filter). Features a minimal logo on the left, centered 14px medium-weight navigation links with a 2px bottom-border active indicator, and a right-aligned utility section containing a notification bell with a red dot badge and a user profile dropdown.

Fixed-width column (320px) containing a vertical stack of white cards. Top card handles configuration with 'apple-select' styled dropdowns (chevron-right 12px icon). Channel selection card uses a grid layout with 8px rounded icon boxes (10% opacity background of the brand color). Scheduling card includes a segmented control (button group) with a 'sliding' white active state background.

Fluid column (700px max) featuring the AI Generator card at the top—utilizing a subtle #8b5cf6/5% gradient and a blurred glow effect in the corner. Below is the main editor card with a horizontal toolbar separated by a 1px #e5e5ea border. Editor area uses 20px bold font for titles and 15px leading-relaxed for body text. Bottom section includes specific input fields for metadata (hashtags, links) with Lucide-style icon prefixes.

Fixed-width column (350px). Top card is a multi-platform previewer with segmented icons for switching views (Telegram, Email, etc.). The content area simulates platform-specific CSS (e.g., Telegram's rounded-bubble message style on a patterned background). Bottom of the column contains the primary action buttons: a secondary neutral button for 'Save Draft' and a high-shadow primary blue button for 'Publish'.

A two-part horizontal layout. Left: A full-width data table for recent activity with clean 1px dividers, 13px bold headers, and 14px medium weight content rows. Right/Bottom: A template library using 4-column grid of image-led cards with gradient headers and descriptive body text, featuring 'shadow-increase' hover effects.

special_ui_components.description: A physical switch component with smooth motion.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a checkbox-based toggle. Track: 42x24px, background #e5e5ea, transitions to #34c759 when checked. Handle: 20x20px white circle, 2px padding from track edges. On check, handle transforms by translateX(18px) with 0.2s duration.

special_ui_components.description: Interactive list item showing platform status.
special_ui_components.prompt: Each list item: 48px height, 12px radius. Left: 32px square icon box with 10% opacity brand color. Middle: Vertical stack of title (14px/500) and status label (12px/400). Status 'Connected' uses #34c759 with a 6px dot. Right: Toggle component.

Container with #E1EAD2 background and dot-pattern overlay. Message bubble: White, 16px radius with a bottom-left 'tail' effect. Inner components include a 140px height image, bold header, 14px body text, and a right-aligned timestamp/view-count row in 11px gray text.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain a high degree of whitespace between sections (24px-32px). USE only soft shadows to define elevation—avoid heavy borders. MUST: Use specific Apple-style iconography (Lucide/Thin weight). NOT: Do not use saturated dark colors or harsh gradients; keep the palette airy and neutral.
